description: Client-only, from the menus (title, multiplayer, disconnected, ... screens). Open a singleplayer world or connect to a server by worldId from list_worlds; without worldId, rejoin the world played last in this game run (after a kick, a server restart or a lost connection). Only servers in the server list, or the one played last, can be joined. Returns immediately: poll get_screen until inWorld is true.

worldId.description: World id from list_worlds or get_screen, e.g. "sp:New World" or "mp:3f2a...". Omit to rejoin the last world.

name: join_world
title: Join a world or server
